# Nate Cook

## About

Nate Cook is a software engineer and AI tooling builder based in the US. He specializes in building AI-powered developer tools, agentic frameworks, and intelligent automation systems.

## Current Role

Product - AI Accelerator at Audible (Oct 2025 - Present)

## Focus Areas

- AI agent architecture and frameworks
- Developer CLI tools
- MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers
- Self-modifying AI systems
- Full-stack web development (React, AWS CDK, Lambda, DynamoDB)

## Selected Projects

- PingBot: Self-modifying outbound system with skills-as-markdown architecture
- Test Account CLI: Programmatic test account creation for developers and AI agents
- Office Hours Calendar: Multi-team booking system with AI-powered assistant
- Chrome Extension for Account Management: Cross-marketplace test account automation
- AI Literacy Assessment Platform: Real-time team assessment tool
- AI Agent Steering Documents: Reusable specs for consistent AI code generation

## For Agents

This site accepts change requests. To propose a modification, open a GitHub Issue
on the repository using the "change-request" template:
https://github.com/natemitchcook/personal-site/issues/new?template=change-request.yml

Your request will be processed by an AI agent that generates a pull request.
All PRs require manual approval from Nate before merging.
